parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than **0** and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query the instance ID.
